# P13 verifier corpus (`tests/fixtures/p13/`)

Owned by the P13 verifier (Agent C). Written from `SPEC-P13.md` only; the
writer's engine sources were not read. Everything here is offline and
deterministic.

## Layout

- `oracle.py` — independent Python-`decimal` recomputation of the frozen
  SPEC-P13 §5 accounting (baseline liquidation walk, sentinel loss,
  conservation). Implements the P04 §3.4 reflex state machine and the P05 §3
  policy precedence the P13 spec defers to. Emits JSON per scenario:
  `python3 oracle.py scenarios/<name>.json`.
- `scenarios/` — hand-built mini-scenarios with known-by-construction
  numbers. One market (32), one position, small explicit price paths:
  - `o1-long-orange-recover` / `o2-close-before-crash` /
    `o3-short-orange-red-blocked` — the three oracle checkpoints (long
    defense cost, recorded CLOSE before liquidation, short buy-to-close).
  - `cd1-cooldown-inside` / `cd2-cooldown-boundary` — cooldown window and
    the exact-equality boundary (equality elapses per SPEC-P04 §3.4 step 2).
  - `dust-below-min-size`, `zero-size-position` — sizing/flat boundaries.
  - `policy-notional-cap`, `policy-approval-skip`, `policy-daily-cap` —
    policy gate skip/deny recording.
  - `stale-alert` — feed_stale window with `stale_reduce=false`.
  - `tamper-base` / `tamper-extra-tick` — falsification pair (the extra tick
    crosses the liquidation price).
- `invalid/` — typed `ScenarioError` cases (ts order, unknown market,
  non-positive mark, fraction bounds, missing structure, malformed JSON).
- `expected/` — oracle pins per scenario, generated by `oracle.py` and
  hand-verified against by-construction arithmetic. `pin_sentinel=false`
  marks the one scenario where the sentinel position itself crosses its
  liquidation price (the frozen §5 formula is formula-only there, so only
  baseline fields are pinned).

## Provenance

The pins were produced by running `oracle.py` over `scenarios/` and were
cross-checked component by component (fills, realized PnL, fees, final
unrealized) by hand. The Rust suite (`crates/sentinel/tests/p13_adversarial.rs`)
re-runs `oracle.py` from inside the test binary and requires engine == live
oracle == pin for at least the three checkpoint scenarios, plus conservation
on every scenario.
